classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Retrieve representative sequences for NAD(P)HX repair proteins annotated with ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase (GO:0070401) and NADPHX epimerase (GO:0070402) activities; characterize them biochemically via sequence analysis; aggregate literature evidence; and produce a ranked candidate list.
assumptions: GO:0070401 corresponds to ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity (NAXD family) and GO:0070402 to NAD(P)H-hydrate epimerase activity (NAXE family) per current GO annotations; these IDs are treated as confirmed assumptions from tool-selection context.
reviewed=true (Swiss-Prot entries only) is preferred for representative-candidate quality; if fewer than 5 sequences are returned per term, a follow-up pass with reviewed=null is recommended.
max_sequences=200 per GO term is sufficient to capture functional diversity within Swiss-Prot without exceeding local memory limits.

ESM3 structural embedding is excluded from this plan because a concrete single-sequence string cannot be resolved from go_sequences output at plan time; it should be added in a subsequent round once top-ranked candidates are identified from rank_designs output.
go_sequences exposes a fasta_path output field pointing to the retrieved multi-FASTA file on disk; sequence_analysis consumes that path directly.
rank_designs uses composition, charge, and motif features returned by sequence_analysis as its ranking signals; no structural prediction or binding-affinity data are available at this stage.
The literature search executes in parallel with sequence retrieval and supplies mechanistic and phylogenetic context for interpreting ranked candidates.

success_criteria.sequences_retrieved_dehydratase: At least 1 reviewed UniProt sequence returned for GO:0070401
success_criteria.sequences_retrieved_epimerase: At least 1 reviewed UniProt sequence returned for GO:0070402
success_criteria.sequence_analyses_complete: sequence_analysis output including composition, region annotations, and per-residue residue table produced for both GO term sets
success_criteria.literature_evidence_found: At least 1 publication record retrieved covering NAD(P)HX repair mechanism or NAXD/NAXE biology
success_criteria.ranking_produced: rank_designs returns a deterministic ordered list of up to 20 representative candidates with composite scores derived from sequence-analysis metrics

inputs.query: NAD(P)HX repair dehydratase epimerase NAXD NAXE metabolite damage
